verdicts.title: Combinatorial approach to multipartite quantum systems:basic formulation
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: In this paper we give a method to associate a graph with an arbitrary density matrix referred to a standard orthonormal basis in the Hilbert space of a finite dimensional quantum system. We study the related issues like classification of pure and mixed states, Von-Neumann entropy, separability of mu
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract concerns associating graphs with density matrices in quantum systems and Von-Neumann entropy of quantum states — it does not address Resolution proof complexity, Tseitin formulas, or proof entropy Φ(π) on expander vs. tree graphs.
